status: PROSPECTIVE; commit before any model execution, model or head selection, or dev row scoring. Both cited projection phases are already materialized and independently verified; no row, label, or model output is read by this protocol.
hypothesis: On the verified source-native projection, the frozen Vey 2 runtime and the pinned Laya English route can be compared on shared evidence for two source-native endpoints, MASSIVE binary intent Choice and MASSIVE retained-rater ordinal Score, with every quantity computed by identical code from identical serving bytes. This is a development comparison; it is not the endgame final, not a Pareto claim, and it does not open any sealed phase.

authority.jev_direct_evidence: Still unauthorized. No authenticated call, account creation, credential use, or paid request is authorized here. Every Jev cell stays UNMEASURED.

data.phase_access: Read only the verified dev projection through neutral_native_compile.open_phase('dev', stream). Never read train, calibration, confirmation, or unused phases. Sealed-phase requests must fail before any file opens.

endpoints.choice: massive.intent only. 63,852 dev decisions, 1,252 independent utterance groups, K=60 intent candidates per row, binary source-native label. Every dev utterance group has exactly two intent decisions, one per polar axis.
endpoints.ordinal_score: massive.grammar_score (5 native levels) and massive.spelling_score (3 native levels), 62,594 labeled dev decisions each. Targets are retained per-rater arrays in original rater order; native missingness is preserved, so 1,258 of 63,852 rows carry no valid ordinal target and stay unlabeled.

excluded_endpoints_and_why.banking77.intent: All 4,105 projected rows are in the train phase, so no dev intent row exists. It also cannot serve a dev comparison even in principle: the frozen Vey lane cannot answer fixed-label classification, since compile_instruction yields an empty program and compose falls back to alphabetical text order.
excluded_endpoints_and_why.massive.intent_nontarget: Excluded by label outcome, not by difficulty. Rows whose gold is the pole label rather than the intent label are excluded from the Choice endpoint by the frozen rule above.

data.exposure_disclosure: MASSIVE is a public benchmark with prior Vey and Laya exposure disclosed. Study sealing controls selection-process leakage only, never universal freshness. Results are legacy replication evidence, not fresh transfer.
data.grouping: component_id and group_id from the projection provenance are the statistical unit. MASSIVE locale descendants share one base utterance group, so 51 locales never multiply independent n. A paired interval resamples base utterance groups, never individual locale rows.
data.license: CC-BY-4.0 dataset-specific grant. Attribution and modification notice required. No raw rows, utterances, or labels enter Git.

vey.route: Frozen vey.decide() with candidates set to the source-native candidate id->description map. state carries the utterance text block. question is the source-native question string verbatim.
vey.artifact: NLI grounder tasksource/ModernBERT-base-nli at revision de4ab7e77845098b7fab7f6ab9d370ddff27b19c plus published comparator fazinahamed/vey at pinned revision 04d22c8b3cff843d7e64c61ab6550ba412898c94.
vey.legal_surface_proved_by_execution: The empty-program alphabetical fallback is a behaviour of the frozen product, not an assumption. The Choice harness must persist the compiled program, decision_mode, and decision state per row so a reader can see which lane and program answered.

laya.route: Pinned English bundle convaiinnovations/laya at snapshot 55cf4c4ebb4ebe31b2550e8bdf3bd21b99753851, weights loaded with safetensors, using the bundle's own rl_common build_sequence/DecisionModel and its published temperature table. The multilingual bundle is not used: MASSIVE dev locale coverage is local and non-English-heavy, and adding a second competitor route mid-protocol would change the arm set. Its evaluation is registered separately.
laya.english_route_only_justification: The registered route rule selects the highest DEV-quality appropriate route per endpoint. Choosing the multilingual route for MASSIVE intent is a legitimate registered alternative. It is preregistered here as a follow-up route selection, not silently skipped.

arms.shared_exact_workflow: Identical row order, identical candidate dictionary and ordering, identical state text, identical truncation, identical metrics code and identical output code. No arm receives model-private summaries or gold.

choice_accuracy.statistic: Unconditional top-1 accuracy over labeled dev rows, plus accuracy on gold-changing locale pairs, both-endpoints-correct rate, changed-to-new rate, and unwanted change on stable gold, reported separately and never pooled.
choice_accuracy.superiority: Paired cluster bootstrap 95% interval excluding zero favorably.

choice_calibration.statistic: NLL and Brier over the full 60-way distribution, plus 15-bin ECE, on the same rows.

ordinal_score.statistic: Expected level from the source rubric, predicted MAE over the native level range, normalized MAE, mean signed error, signed-error slope against the observed rater mean, and RPS over the level distribution. Reported per level count and per locale.
ordinal_score.calibration_limit: Targets are retained per-rater arrays, not population probabilities. Population calibration claims are prohibited. NLL/Brier against a retained-rater distribution is reportable only when at least three raters rated the row.

endpoints_and_margins.frozen_primary: choice_accuracy is the single frozen primary endpoint for this development comparison. Ordinal Score and calibration are secondary and preregistered but cannot retroactively become primary after outcomes exist.
endpoints_and_margins.familywise: Two-sided nominal 95% Bonferroni intervals across every preregistered endpoint versus each directly evaluated competitor. Cluster bootstrap resamples base utterance groups with 10000 resamples, seed 0.
endpoints_and_margins.zero_discordance: Degenerate bootstrap or zero observed harmful discordance is not non-inferiority. Require the exact paired-discordance Clopper-Pearson harmful-event upper bound to clear the frozen margin, or a deterministic proof of identical outputs.

controls: Vey empty-program fallback control: report the fraction of dev rows whose compiled program is empty, because an empty program makes the Vey Choice answer alphabetical rather than semantic.
Laya route control: report the exact bundle revision, config, temperature table applied, and marker truncation count per row, since the head marker budget silently shrinks long options.

Label-free permutation control: on a fixed seeded subset, shuffle dev gold and confirm both arms collapse toward their prior-implied chance under shuffled labels, catching any arm that ignores serving input.

Shared-exact-workflow control: assert identical row ids, candidate ids, candidate order, state text and question string for both arms on every scored row, computed from persisted per-row records rather than asserted.

gates.no_sealed_access: Zero reads of train, calibration, confirmation or unused phases. Any sealed request must fail before file access.
gates.row_level_persistence: Every scored dev row persists id, group_id, locale, endpoint, arm, answer, per-candidate distribution or scores, decision_mode, compiled program, and input digests. Aggregate-only output is a failure, not a summary.
gates.determinism: Re-running any arm on a fixed 512-row subset reproduces identical answers and distributions bit for bit.
gates.mechanism: The comparison reports what each arm did, not only which number won. An arm failing an endpoint leaves that endpoint unmeasured or failed, never reframed.

resource_budget.arms_serialized: Run Vey and Laya in separate processes, never concurrently. Estimated VRAM: ModernBERT-large Laya head at FP32 is about 1.7GB weights plus activations; Vey NLI plus comparator is about 0.6GB. Both fit the 12GB budget, but serialization is mandatory.

failure_branches.vey_empty_program: If the Vey empty-program fraction is above 0.95, the Vey arm is not a legal Choice arm on this source. Record the frozen product's Choice limitation as a MEASURED scope fact, record the Choice cell as Vey-not-applicable, and keep the ordinal Score cell, which does have a legal Vey surface only if a Score entrypoint exists; it does not in the frozen product, so record that too. Do not write a proxy scorer and call it the product.
failure_branches.laya_load_failure: Retain the failure receipt. Do not substitute a different bundle, revision, or the multilingual route without a committed amendment.
failure_branches.sealed_access_attempt: Fail closed, retain the failure, and do not proceed with the comparison.
failure_branches.pass: This development comparison earns no promotion, no Pareto credit and no endgame completion. Record the endpoints it measured and register the next branch.
